description: The 'cluster_tasks_by_projectKey' dataset is designed to provide insights into task management and scheduling across various projects. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique project identified by the 'projectKey'. The dataset includes temporal metrics such as the earliest and latest start times ('start_time_min' and 'start_time_max'), which help in understanding the scheduling and execution timeline of tasks within a project. Additionally, it provides duration metrics, including the maximum and average duration of tasks in seconds ('duration_seconds_max' and 'duration_seconds_avg'), offering insights into task efficiency and time management. The dataset also tracks the age of tasks in days, from minimum to maximum ('age_days_min' and 'age_days_max'), which can be useful for analyzing task lifecycle and project timelines. The 'count' column indicates the number of tasks associated with each project, providing a measure of project activity. This dataset is valuable for project managers and analysts looking to optimize task scheduling, improve time management, and gain a comprehensive view of project timelines and task durations.
shortDesc: Project task clustering dataset with time and duration metrics.
